## Loading files and reading the data
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)


# Read csv files contianing the attendance data
all_years_files <- 
  list.files(
    path = "MDSDATA",
    # see regular expressions
    pattern = ".csv$" ,
    full.names = TRUE
  )


all_years_data <-
  lapply(all_years_files, read_csv)

all_years_data
```
